name: Squat
description: Lowering the hips from a standing position and then standing back up while keeping the back straight

name: Bench Press
description: Lying flat on a bench and pressing a weight

name: Deadlift
description: Lifting a weighted barbell from the floor to hip level while maintaining a flat back

name: Pull-Up
description: Pulling the body upward while hanging from a horizontal bar until the chin passes the bar

name: Plank
description: Holding a position similar to a push-up while resting on your forearms or hands

name: Running
description: A high-intensity gait where both feet are briefly off the ground at the same time

name: Burpees
description: A four-point movement squat, kick feet back into a plank, perform a push-up, jump feet back to squat, and jump into the air

name: Cycling
description: Using a stationary or outdoor bicycle to pedal at various intensities to improve heart health

name: Jump Rope
description: Swinging a rope over the head and under the feet repeatedly

name: Static Stretch
description: Holding a muscle in a lengthened position for 30–90 seconds to reduce tightness

name: Single-Leg Stand
description: Standing on one foot while maintaining an upright posture to improve neurological stability

name: Downward Dog
description: A yoga pose forming an inverted 'V' shape with the body to stretch the hamstrings
